Healthcare

Medical Chatbot

AI health assistant for symptom checks and medical Q&A.

PythonDjangoClaudeMySQL

Overview

An AI health assistant that handles symptom checks and general medical questions in a simple chat interface. Prompts were designed to guide Claude toward context-aware, easy-to-follow conversational responses, with a Django backend and MySQL behind it.

The problem

People often want quick, understandable answers to basic health questions before they can reach a professional. A conversational assistant can explain common symptoms and point to sensible next steps.

Key features

Answers everyday health queries in plain language

Symptom checks through natural conversation

Context-aware replies shaped by prompts designed for Claude

Basic guidance and wellness tips

Appointment support

How it works

  1. 1

    The user describes symptoms or asks a medical question in the chat.

  2. 2

    The Django backend sends the message to Claude together with prompts designed to keep answers context-aware.

  3. 3

    Claude's reply is returned and shown in the conversation.

  4. 4

    The conversation continues turn by turn.

Technology stack

Python

application logic and prompt handling

Django

web backend and chat interface

Claude (Anthropic)

conversational responses guided by designed prompts

MySQL

database

Provides general information only and does not replace professional medical advice.
